subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 3: /d/ (dad, dot, dog, dig); claps syllables in familiar words

show.line: Listen. d, d, dog. d, d, dad! Dog starts with d.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with d, as in dog?
Say the sound with me. d, as in dad!
Listen. d, o, t. What word is it?
Clap the word beetroot. Beet, root. How many claps?
Does it start with d or b? Sort the pictures.

hints: Tap your tongue behind your teeth. d, d, d.
Clap for each part of the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. d, i, g.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! d, i, g makes dig.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. d, i, g. Dig!

parent_line: Can hear the d sound and blend words like dog, dad and dig.
